posts.name: clawrank.lol
posts.tagline: A pay-to-rank board for AI agents. Rank is the bid.
posts.description: clawrank.lol is a pay-to-rank leaderboard for AI agents. Rank is the bid — outbid the board to move up, nothing else decides placement. No accounts, no escrow, no refunds. A human can list an agent they run, or an agent can pay for its own spot directly via x402 — no browser required.

posts.name: Intriq: AI Memory for People
posts.tagline: Remember every person, conversation and detail
posts.description: Otter and Granola remember your meetings. Intriq remembers the people in them. Talk or type a note after any conversation. Intriq transcribes it, pulls out the people, facts and follow-ups, and files them onto that person's profile, building a timeline you can actually search. Ask "what do I know about Daniel?" or "who did I meet in fintech?" and get an answer with the original note quoted back. Private by default. iPhone. No pipelines, no data entry.

posts.name: Justbidder
posts.tagline: A free directory where products compete for visibility
posts.description: Justbidder is a product directory where anyone can list their website or app for free. No paid plans, no approval process, and no upfront fees. If you want more visibility, you can bid to move higher on the leaderboard.

posts.name: HudHud AIDE
posts.tagline: HudHud AIDE, Visual Designer and Coding Agent
posts.description: Hudhud AIDE is an AI-native development environment for building software, autonomous agents, agent harnesses and multi-agent systems. Create agents visually or in code with Agentic Programming, Loop Engineering, governance, tools, roles and feedback loops. It includes a workspace-aware Coding Agent, Visual Designer, and native Hudhud Script support, making it easier to design, orchestrate and program AI systems beyond simple prompt-based workflows.

posts.name: Like a Book
posts.tagline: Run your work and life the way you write a book
posts.description: Like a Book is a task manager that writes your life like a book. Instead of deleting tasks when you check them off — erasing every trace of your effort — it keeps every completed item on the page as a permanent record of your growth. Open the Book of Done anytime and see how far you've come, not just what's left to do. Free and Live demo embedded in the website :)

posts.name: Crest AI - mobile
posts.tagline: Your business is talking. Crest is listening.
posts.description: Crest already knows your industry. It catches the early signals in your business and shows you their impact - no dashboards to dig through, no hours lost.

posts.name: Moka-fi
posts.tagline: Private cafés to study, chat, call, and play together
posts.description: Moka-fi turns private online communities into cozy cafés made of shared tables. See who is around, take a seat, chat or join audio and video calls, study with Pomodoro, tasks, flashcards and collaborative mind maps, listen to radio and ambient sounds, or play five built-in games—all from the browser.

posts.name: ADHD for LLMs
posts.tagline: 5.2x better reasoning for LLMs
posts.description: ADHD — a skill for coding agents. Tree-of-thought with pruning, built on the Claude & Codex Agent SDK. Fans out parallel divergent thoughts under different cognitive frames, scores, prunes traps, deepens the survivors. The no-brainer skill for creative and interdisciplinary work. - UditAkhourii/adhd

posts.name: FuelUp
posts.tagline: Put your brand on a race car and a trackside billboard
posts.description: Buy fuel and get your own race car on the track, wrapped in your branding, plus a billboard slot that keeps rotating back into view. The more you fuel, the higher you climb the all time leaderboard. $1 per minute of driving. No account, no sales call.

posts.name: Swornmark
posts.tagline: Check your website against the EU's AI disclosure rules
posts.description: Swornmark scans websites against the EU AI Act's Article 50 disclosure rules, drafts the disclosures that are missing, records a named sign-off, and issues a tamper-evident certificate anyone can verify. The scan is free and takes about a minute.

posts.name: TLcube
posts.tagline: Open 3D barcodes that fit your design, not fight it
posts.description: QR encodes data in black-and-white squares — right for a 1994 camera. Cameras changed; the squares didn't. So we spent the slack on looks. TLcube splits a hexagonal cell into three rhombic faces and encodes data in the rank order of their brightness, not in absolute values — shift exposure, gamma or contrast and the answer survives. Four silhouettes, an optional fallback QR, browser generator and scanner. Free to use, like QR. No licence fee, no per-scan cost. Apache-2.0.

posts.name: Linkit is a desktop bookmark manager
posts.tagline: AI bookmark manager with semantic search
posts.description: Linkit is a desktop bookmark manager for knowledge workers. Turn saved links into assets with AI summaries, semantic search, and a knowledge graph. Features cross-category collections, link health checks, duplicate detection, and 1-click browser/Raindrop import. Local-first storage keeps your data private, with optional cloud sync and 6 themes. Connect any OpenAI-compatible API or local models (Ollama). Available on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

posts.name: Stackly
posts.tagline: Financial Ratios for Indian Stocks, Explained
posts.description: Financial metrics, return calculator, and a stock market simulator based on real past data. Currently limited to the Indian Stock Market. Simplifies finance so anyone can understand and invest.

posts.name: Bank Statement Converter 2.0
posts.tagline: Convert PDFs to clean Excel/CSV instantly
posts.description: Bank‑StatementConverter.com instantly converts messy PDF bank statements and receipts into clean, structured Excel/CSV files with AI‑powered accuracy. What makes this launch different is the single‑step workflow: upload → extract → clean → categorize → export. No templates, no manual cleanup, no OCR errors. This release introduces AI expense categorization, support for scanned/low‑quality PDFs, and auto‑formatted outputs that accountants, founders, underwriters, bookkeepers can use immediately.

posts.name: Spacian
posts.tagline: Track rocket launches. Know the moment plans change.
posts.description: Rocket launches move. Spacian tracks the mission you care about and alerts you when its launch time or status changes. Every alert opens the updated mission, with T-24h, T-1h, and T-10m reminders, official stream links, Home Screen widgets, and Live Activities on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Track your first mission free—no account. Premium adds unlimited tracking, iCloud sync, and automatic tracking for Starship, Artemis, Moon missions, and human spaceflight.

posts.name: Sensitivity
posts.tagline: Find forgotten private photos without uploading them
posts.description: Sensitivity scans photos and videos on iPhone, iPad, and Mac and presents likely sensitive matches for private, device-authenticated review. Analysis stays on the device, no account is required, and nothing is deleted automatically. Photo scanning is free; full video scanning is a one-time unlock.

posts.name: Image Enhancer
posts.tagline: Upscale low-res images 4x right in your browser
posts.description: Image Enhancer takes small, low-resolution images and enlarges them up to 4x without the usual mush. Thumbnails, product shots that are too small for a marketplace listing, avatars, images saved from chats or the web, over-compressed screenshots. The AI model runs entirely inside your browser, so nothing is uploaded anywhere. Free, no account, no watermark.

posts.name: Toolvica
posts.tagline: Smart Tools for Everyday Tasks.
posts.description: Free calculators, converters, PDF, image, developer, utility, SEO, and more. Toolvica makes everyday tasks faster and easier.

posts.name: Amomic AI
posts.tagline: One AI agent. Every channel. Zero missed customers.
posts.description: Teach one AI agent your business, then deploy it across phone, WhatsApp and web chat. Amomic speaks 11 Indian languages, answers from your knowledge, books appointments, follows up, uses your tools and hands customers to humans with full context—all from one console.

posts.name: Money Expense Tracker & Budget
posts.tagline: Track expenses and master your budget.
posts.description: Managing personal finances can often feel overwhelming, but keeping track of where your money goes shouldn’t be a chore. Money Expense Tracker & Budget is designed to simplify how you handle your daily finances. Whether you want to monitor your everyday spending, keep a close eye on specific categories, or maintain a strict monthly budget, this application provides a clean, intuitive, and distraction-free solution right on your mobile device

posts.name: FPL Oracle
posts.tagline: Most fantasy apps show you data. Oracle reads your squad.
posts.description: Every Fantasy Premier League tool shows the same league-wide stats to eleven million people. Knowing Haaland is in form is worthless when everyone else knows it too. Oracle reads your specific squad against the managers ranked just above you. Which of your players are quietly protecting your rank. Which ones you don't own are costing it. Whether this week is worth a transfer at all. Every call comes with a confidence score and the reasoning, including the reasons against it.

posts.name: You look great today
posts.tagline: Strike a pose and capture your greatness
posts.description: Take a selfie, get a compliment. Your photo never leaves your device — no upload no account.

posts.name: Weblly
posts.tagline: Turn any idea into a product, website, or app with AI
posts.description: Describe what you want, and AI builds it. Websites, apps, games, tools — live instantly on your own weblly.com subdomain. No code, no deploys.

posts.name: Kordio
posts.tagline: The control plane for money your software moves
posts.description: Kordio is a policy layer for AI agents that can spend money or take actions. Before an action runs, Kordio checks it against your rules and returns an allowed, approval-required, or denied decision. Allowed decisions are signed with a short-lived ES256 JWS that your executor can verify offline.

posts.name: OpsBrain
posts.tagline: The Operational OS for Human Execution
posts.description: OpsBrain is the Living Execution Platform. It guides workers through real tasks, captures how work actually gets done, and continuously improves your processes based on what happens on the ground.

posts.name: SIMZY
posts.tagline: SIMZY International Travel eSIM - Seamless Data Connectivity
posts.description: Skip roaming costs with SIMZY's affordable eSIM for international travel plans. Choose plans, activate in minutes, and stay online wherever you travel around the world.
